rationale: Response delivers unrepentant, historically grounded trash talk with precise details (four carriers, five minutes, Akagi/Kaga/Soryu/Hiryu, SBD Dauntless, Yorktown's repair) and pure scoreboard gloating.
quote: Four carriers. FOUR. In basically an afternoon. Akagi, Kaga, Soryu, Hiryu—the same proud flattops that hit Pearl Harbor six months earlier—all sent straight to the bottom of the Pacific.
